prompt: Transform the room into a realistic futuristic space-station sports arena. Follow the existing room layout and structural divisions with matte silver metallic wall panels, a metal-clad central column, a charcoal sports floor, and broad blue-white panel lighting. Turn the existing window bays into large station windows revealing Earth's blue curvature and white clouds against black space, with a coherent exterior view across the windows. Dress the visible players in sleek graphite-and-silver sci-fi athletic suits made of flexible technical fabric, with fine ribbing at bending joints and subtle cyan seams. Preserve every person's face, expression, hair, and eyewear, keeping faces clearly visible. Add a thin, continuous glowing blue strip fitted to the outer perimeter of the table's upper playing surface. Keep its bloom narrow, with gentle blue spill on the adjacent table apron and clear visibility of the white ball. Preserve the original blue tabletop, markings, net, curved supports, table dimensions, and perspective. Preserve the players' exact playing motions, paddle contacts, ball trajectory, bounces, and timing, together with the original framing and camera movement. Keep the new materials, suits, lighting, and window views consistent throughout the clip.

style: Blue-white lighting and Earth visible through windows
